script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Family
Theme: career transition

Begin screenplay.

Title: "New Beginnings"

INT. KITCHEN - MORNING

JANE (30s, a worn-out marketing executive) looks tired, disheveled, and overwhelmed as she sips her lukewarm coffee. Her husband MIKE (early 40s) enters, noticing her sadness.

MIKE
(smiling)
Long day at the office?

JANE
(sighs, nods)
Another one. I can't do this much longer.

INT. LIVING ROOM - DAY

Jane sits on the couch, staring blankly at the TV. Mike enters, handing her a flyer.

MIKE
(encouragingly)
Have you seen this? The local community college is offering a free career transition seminar tonight. It might be just what you need.

JANE
(skeptical)
Another seminar? I've been to so many already.

MIKE
(firmly)
This one is different. It's led by successful professionals who have made the transition themselves.

INT. CAREER TRANSITION SEMINAR - NIGHT

Jane arrives at the seminar, apprehensive but hopeful. She meets other attendees, all struggling with their own career transition issues. A PRESENTER, a charismatic and successful entrepreneur, shares her inspiring story.

PRESENTER
(energetically)
Remember, it's never too late to follow your passion. I made the transition from a corporate lawyer to a small business owner, and I couldn't be happier.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

Jane meets with a small group of fellow attendees to discuss their career transition plans. They share ideas, resources, and encouragement. Jane begins to feel a renewed sense of purpose.

INT. HOME OFFICE - EVENING

Jane begins researching potential career paths and businesses she could start. She researches markets, competitors, and develops a business plan.

INT. KITCHEN - MORNING

Mike enters the kitchen, finding Jane excitedly pouring over her research.

MIKE
(amused)
What's got you so energized this morning?

JANE
(smiling)
I've decided to start my own business. I've got a plan, and I'm going to make it happen.

INT. COMMUNITY COLLEGE CLASSROOM - DAY

Jane attends a business start-up class at the community college. She learns valuable skills and meets mentors who help guide her through the process of starting her business.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

Jane meets with her small business group for support and advice. They celebrate her progress and offer encouragement as she prepares to launch her business.

INT. HOME OFFICE - EVENING

Jane works late into the night, finalizing her business plan and preparing for her launch. She feels a newfound sense of purpose and excitement.

INT. NEW BUSINESS LOCATION - DAY

Jane opens the doors to her new business, surrounded by friends, family, and members of her small business group. She reflects on the long journey that led her here, grateful for the support and encouragement she received along the way.

FADE OUT.

End screenplay.
